title: Potato grown under Nordic conditions 2018-2019
projectDescription: Comparison of leaves from potato grown in different fields during 2018 and 2019
sampleProcessingProtocol: Leaves were frozen in liquid nitrogen and ground to a powder in a mortar. 50 mg of leaf powder was transferred to a 2 ml tube and 500 µl extraction buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8,5, 5 mM EDTA, 100 mM KCl, 1% DTT, 30% sucrose, 1 mM PMSF, Protease inhibitor cocktail) was added. The sample was vortexed for 30 seconds and 500 µL of ice-cold buffered phenol was added. The sample was then vortexed for 15 minutes at 4 °C followed by centrifugation for 3 min at 4° C, 6000 x g. The phenolic upper phase was collected and mixed with 500 µL ice-cold extraction buffer. The sample was vortexed again for 30 s followed by centrifugation for 3 min at 4° C, 6000 x g. The phenolic upper phase was resuspended in five volumes of ammonium acetate buffer (100 mM ammonium acetate in methanol) and incubated over night at -20 °C. The following day the sample was centrifuged for 30 min at 4° C, 16000 x g. The supernatant was removed and 500 µl of DTT solution (0.2% DTT (w/v) in acetone) was added to the pellet. The pellet was resuspended by sonication with a tip sonicator (2 times for 10 sec at 5 S). The sample was then incubated for 1 h at -20 °C and centrifuged for 30 min at 4° C, 16000 x g. The supernatant was removed, 500 µl of DTT solution was added to the pellet and the pellet was resuspended by sonication with a tip sonicator (2 times for 10 sec at 5 S). The sample was then incubated for 1 h at -20 °C and centrifuged for 10 min at 4° C, 16000 x g. The supernatant was removed and the pellet was allowed to air-dry. The pellet was then resuspended in resuspension buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl pH 7,5, 2 mM EDTA, 4% SDS, 1 mM DTT, 1 mM PMSF, Protease inhibitor cocktail (Sigma P9599)). The samples were then stored at -80 °C. For tryptic digestion, DTT was added to the sample to a final concentration of 10 mM followed by a 10-minute incubation at 95 °C. Subsequently, iodoacetamide was added to a final concentration of 55 mM and the samples were incubated for 30 minutes in the dark. The samples were then analyzed on SDS-PAGE until the front had migrated approximately 5 mm into the gel. The pieces were excised, washed and the protein was digested with trypsin in-gel. The tryptic peptides were cleaned with C18 columns (UltraMicro spin columns) and resuspended in a solution of 5% formic acid in water.
dataProcessingProtocol: Raw data files were converted to mzML and MGF using ProteoWizard. MGF files were searched using MS-GF+ and X!Tandem against potato proteome in UniProt as of 17 January 2017 expanded with an equal number of reverse protein entries. Identifications were filtered in Proteios Softare Environment at a PSM q-value threshold of 0.004 (q-value threshold 0.1 for peptides identified q<0.004 elsewhere in the dataset) and matched to MS1 features extracted using Dinosaur. MS2 identitites were further propagated between runs in Proteios and data were exported as a peptide table with MS1 feature intensities.
